title: Qualify installed agent brief access under real Codex sandbox
description: First computer-use audit stopped before browser work: installed torch brief returned ERR_SQLITE_ERROR/database read-only in owner-console session. Same exact installed brief succeeds on host. Diagnose precise persistence/audit/write roots and sandbox expectations; provide least-privilege read/authorized-write handling, not chmod, DB copying, danger-full-access or ignoring the startup guard. Cover live installed worktree startup with a regression and verify same durable identity/session is resumed. This is a real blocker costing the audit turn.
acceptanceCriteria: Current installed brief succeeds under the documented approved sandbox permission boundary
Read-only operations do not silently require unapproved global writes
No weakened guards, world-writable DB, foreign installation state or broad sandbox disablement
A regression reproduces restricted-write state access and verifies explicit actionable outcome
